title: VIGIL authorship, human-review and human-verification provenance
scope: VIGIL-authored extraction, abstraction, classification, interpretation, crosswalking, applicability assessment, analysis and record production
operating_model: AI-authored, semi-autonomous production under human contract approval

content_origin.human-authored: The substantive content was authored by a human.
content_origin.ai-authored: The substantive content was authored by an AI system.
content_origin.human-ai-coauthored: A human and an AI system each made substantive authorship contributions.
content_origin.deterministically-generated: The artefact was mechanically produced from identified upstream data without substantive authorship in the generation step.

generation_mode.manual: Content was produced without AI generation.
generation_mode.ai-assisted: A human author used AI assistance while retaining substantive authorship responsibility.
generation_mode.semi-autonomous: An AI system performed substantive work under a bounded human-approved contract and execution constraints.
generation_mode.deterministic-generation: A deterministic process produced the artefact from identified upstream inputs.

human_role.none: No human role is established for the artefact.
human_role.contract-approver: A human established or approved the objective, boundaries or repository action; this does not establish authorship, review or verification.
human_role.substantive-contributor: A human made a substantive contribution but is not necessarily a co-author, reviewer or verifier.
human_role.co-author: A human made a substantive authorship contribution jointly with an AI system or another author.
human_role.reviewer: A human performed the review represented by the separate human_review_status field.
human_role.verifier: A human performed the verification represented by the separate human_verification_status field.

human_review_status.not-reviewed: No substantive human review is established.
human_review_status.spot-checked: A human inspected a limited sample or selected aspects; completeness is not established.
human_review_status.substantively-reviewed: A human reviewed the artefact's material substance, but line-by-line review is not asserted.
human_review_status.line-by-line-reviewed: A human reviewed the complete artefact line by line.

human_verification_status.not-verified: No independent human verification is established.
human_verification_status.sample-verified: A human verified a limited sample; full source coverage is not established.
human_verification_status.source-verified: A human checked the material claims against identified sources.
human_verification_status.fully-verified: A human completed the defined full-verification procedure for the artefact.

inheritance_rules.historical_uncertainty_rule: Do not manufacture retrospective specificity. Apply the repository default unless contemporaneous evidence establishes an artefact-level exception.

external_source_boundary: External laws, standards, publications, incident reports and other evidentiary materials retain their own authorship and authority. This declaration concerns VIGIL's extraction, abstraction, classification, interpretation, crosswalking, applicability assessment, analysis and record production; it does not label the external source itself as AI-authored.

cam-applicability-layer-2.layer_boundary: Layer 2 may reference effective Layer 1 EXTREQ records but must not rewrite Layer 0 source facts or Layer 1 external requirement meaning.

post_production_assurance_rule.rule: A later human review or verification is additional assurance over an existing artefact. It must be recorded separately and must not change an AI-authored artefact into a human-authored artefact.

generated_artefact_rule.rule: Deterministic generation describes only the mechanical generation step. It does not upgrade or replace the authorship, review or verification provenance of upstream content.
